scientific_integrity: Direct analytic factorization and separated-column witness; the order-language obstruction is classical and the shared approximation-number tail is credited to prior work.
scientific_limitations: Hilbert factorization is proved for real injective-graph language Hankel operators. The bound is not asserted optimal; no classification or effective test for all weakly compact language Hankel operators is claimed. Earlier equivalent weakly almost periodic examples have not been ruled out.
title: Hilbert-factorable nonregular language Hankel operators from injective graphs
